question: On ESP32 chip revision v0.0, repeated consecutive writes to the same DPORT register address sometimes get lost, both for UART2 FIFO and for GPIO_OUT1_W1TC. What workaround should I use?

generation.answer: For UART2 FIFO, use the equivalent AHB address not the DPORT address when writing the same register address in sequential instructions ([Page 1]). For GPIO_OUT1_W1TC, disable CPU interrupts before reading these five FIFO registers and enable CPU interrupts after read access ([Page 2]).
